name: Home Market (Hong Kong)
scene_safe_description: A Hong Kong nonprofit chain that sells food and everyday goods near cost to eligible disadvantaged residents, and offers jobs to people with disabilities.
lens: Social/community infrastructure: affordable neighborhood retail. Participation in value creation: inclusive employment, not evidence that all customers co-own or co-govern the business.
verified_output_or_outcome: Its official About Us page reports 17 branches. This establishes operating scale; it does not establish a causal reduction in poverty, isolation or distress.
scene_safe_line: Home Market makes everyday necessities more affordable through nonprofit neighborhood shops, while creating employment opportunities for people with disabilities.
evidence_type: Organization-reported operations and output; no causal evaluation verified in this targeted check.

name: Food Angel (Hong Kong)
scene_safe_description: Food Angel converts safe surplus food, supplemented by purchased ingredients, into free meals and food packages distributed through charity partners and its own community services.
lens: Social/community infrastructure: collection, kitchens and distribution connect resources to needs. Contribution/local feedback: volunteers and donors can contribute to a visible local service; this is an interpretive mechanism, not a measured psychological effect.
verified_output_or_outcome: Its official service page reports approximately 300 charity partners and says they distribute 70% of its meals. Its community centre offers two onsite meals daily plus activities; outreach pairs food delivery with contact for homebound elders.
scene_safe_line: Food Angel connects donated food, kitchens and neighborhood partners, turning surplus into meals and regular human contact.
evidence_type: Organization-reported service outputs. Do not present meals served as proof of reduced loneliness, improved health or restored agency.

name: Preston community wealth-building (England)
scene_safe_description: Preston's council and other anchor institutions use procurement and local ownership initiatives to retain more economic activity locally.
lens: Contribution/local feedback: institutional spending supports local suppliers and employment. Participation in value creation: wider ownership is part of the model, but procurement and cooperative development should not be conflated.
verified_output_or_outcome: Beyond descriptive procurement figures, Rose et al. (2025) evaluated employment using 2011–2019 individual survey data, difference-in-differences and entropy balancing (95,476 responses; 16 comparison local authorities). The estimated absolute employment-rate increase associated with the programme was 4 percentage points (95% CI 2.4–5.7).
scene_safe_line: Preston shows how major local institutions can direct purchasing toward local suppliers so that more of their spending supports the surrounding economy.
causal_caution: Quasi-experimental evidence, not a randomized trial. Unobserved changing local factors may remain; the study evaluates a multicomponent place-based programme and does not isolate each mechanism. It does not directly measure individual alignment or agency. The article writes '4%' but uses an absolute-rate linear-model estimate; avoid '4% relative growth'.
evidence_type: Official programme description plus primary quasi-experimental evaluation.

name: MONDRAGON cooperatives (Spain)
scene_safe_description: MONDRAGON is a group of self-governing cooperatives. Its stated principles give cooperative members one vote each on governing bodies and major issues, participation in management, and profit allocation related to members' work.
lens: Participation in value creation: member ownership, democratic governance and participation in results. Contribution/local feedback: work, voice and shared returns are institutionally linked.
verified_output_or_outcome: MONDRAGON's 2025 annual report reports more than 71,400 people employed and more than 1,300 new jobs. These are corporate-reported employment results, not proof that the cooperative structure caused them or improved well-being.
scene_safe_line: In MONDRAGON's cooperatives, members can share in ownership, decisions and results, giving participation an institutional form.
evidence_type: Primary organizational principles and annual-report outputs.
scope_caution: Use 'cooperative members', not 'every employee worldwide': the stated membership rights do not establish that all employees of every subsidiary are member-owners. The annual-report webpage title says 2024, but its text and footer explicitly identify the 2025 report.
